text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... What a perfect day for a nap. 
Alright, right around here... Hm?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hey, SteGo. What a coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hello~. Feels like it's been a while since 
we ran into each other here~.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
You guys never change, do you? If you're 
taking a nap, this is the place after all.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You'd be hard-pressed to find a better 
spot than this, y'know~

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Meow~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Well, well, are you here to greet 
Ste-go too, meow~?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Did you get bigger while I wasn't looking? 
There, there... You look healthy.

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Meow... meow.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah... H-Hey, stop following me...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha, it's really taken a liking to 
Taishin-san~

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I-It's nothing...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Taishin, why don't you keep them company? 
I'll be resting up in the tree."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Alright, the hammock's mine!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'll just be rolling around over there 
someplace, so don't mind me~.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ……Good grief, you're hopeless……

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Hup. —Yep, prime seating.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, the wind feels so nice. The clouds 
and time itself are just drifting by 
slowly.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's so nice and warm~... What a peaceful 
afternoon...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...For a cat, you've got zero guard up. 
...Fufu."

text_block_list.name: Students in Tracksuits
text_block_list.text:
"Phew, glad there's some open space!" 
"Alright, let's review the choreo from 
yesterday! One, two, three, four!"

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Meooow...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah... ......They left.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, it's been a lively day, hasn't it? 
...Well, days like this happen."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Wanna go... somewhere quieter and more 
relaxing than here?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, sounds nice. I kind of feel like 
seeing where this wind leads, too.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I've heard rumors that Stego-san sleeps in 
totally hidden spots~. I'm gonna get my 
hopes up!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hey, Taishin-san, aren't you curious too?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well... a little.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wow-o... The fluffy grass feels so nice.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...It's super quiet. There are hardly any 
people around, which is great."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
While out on my roadwork, I caught sight 
of a patch of golden sunlight. Couldn't 
help but stop and dawdle for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"I use this area for roadwork too. Though 
I had no idea this place existed."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Wander off the beaten path as much 
as I do, and you'll get there eventually.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... As expected, you really are a 
genius at finding hidden spots.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Well, it looks like I'll be able to get 
a good night's sleep.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
What do you think~...? How about we make a 
nap map together~...? *mumble mumble*

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Oh, nice! A treasure map, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: *yawn*... Yeah, that sounds nice...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Maybe I'll take a nap before 
thinking about it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the academy, I 
spotted Stay Gold and the others. It's an 
unusual group, I wonder what brought them 
together.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Trainer! ...What's up? What's with the 
weird face?
choice_data_list: Did you get to refresh yourself?
Did you get to refresh yourself?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Trainer! ...What's up? What's with the 
weird face?
choice_data_list: Did you get to refresh yourself?
Did you get to refresh yourself?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Fellow migratory birds sharing a nice 
perch... perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Comrades solely for the early 
afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, spot on. Thanks to that, as you can 
see, I'm bursting with energy."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...All right, I'm going for one more run.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
After a good rest, you'll be greeted by 
the best view. That's just how it goes!
